title: fix(metadata-protocol, plugin-security): judge a permission set's seal, lock and write intent by (package, name)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #34226

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a save, a draft save or a draft's publish that a package addresses to its own permission set N, refused 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("provided by a managed package and is sealed") while a package of another namespace ships N, now lands; the exported `MetadataAuthoringGateContext` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`) and `PermissionSetLockGateContext` (`@objectstack/plugin-security`) each gain an optional `packageId`; nothing the save door accepted is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:包 crm 发布了权限集 N 时,另一命名空间的包 hr 现在可以保存、草稿保存并发布它自己的权限集 N,hr 的授权只生效 hr 自己的 N;凡是覆盖 crm 所发布 N 的保存(不指定包、指定 crm、指定 crm 的定制配对包、指定 crm 同命名空间的包)仍按原样封存拒绝。
- 为什么改:ADR-0150 D2 规定权限集按「包 + 名称」区分,但托管封存、plugin-security 的打包权限集锁和存储层写入意图都只看名称,把别的包的同名集当成自己的封存基线,误拒了合法保存。
- 风险与回滚:风险在判断「这次保存是否覆盖某个已发布集」的谓词;它复用安装门与保存门共用的命名空间谓词 `permissionSetHoldersMeet` 与配对判定 `isPairOf`,只在「写入方与每个发布方都不同命名空间、且不是其配对包」时放行。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`(封存谓词 `isOwnPermissionSetWrite`),`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.ts`(锁的同一判定),`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` 与 `protocol-history-and-publish.ts` 中各一行写入意图。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts`,预期 37 个全部通过,其中 `[#34226]` 一组覆盖两种注册顺序下的放行、全部封存对照,以及无法回滚的运行时上批量发布被拒后的撤销。
- 需要你做的:评审本次声明的放宽(权限集保存与草稿发布两处门)。

## What changes

A permission set is `(package, name)`, with one set of a name per namespace (ADR-0150 D2/D9). The managed seal (ADR-0126 / ADR-0131 D6) keeps protecting a package's own shipped base. Four judges decided "is this write an override of a shipped set?" by the name alone. All four now judge the package the write is addressed to, through one verdict:

- **The verdict** (`metadata-protocol`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`): `isOwnPermissionSetWrite(engine, type, name, packageId)`. It is true only for a `permission` write addressed to a package P such that, for every package Q that ships the name, P is not Q's customization pair (`isPairOf`) and P does not meet Q under `permissionSetHoldersMeet`. The second test covers Q itself, a co-owner of Q's namespace, a platform namespace, a package with no namespace, and a name the platform requests by spelling. Every shipper is judged, never the first found.
- **The save door's seal** (`refusePackagedBaseOverride`): does not seal such a write. The read-only named-base limb stays ahead of it, unchanged.
- **The repository's managed seal**: the write intent the save door (`protocol-save.ts`) and the draft promotion (`protocol-history-and-publish.ts`) hand the store is `runtime-only` for such a write, not `override-artifact`. One line each, plus the import.
- **The undo of a refused package publish** (`undoLandedPromotions`, `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`): on a runtime that cannot roll back, each undo write judges the package it addresses with the same verdict: the active-row restore or removal at the package the promotion wrote, the returned draft at the draft's own binding. Before, the undo of a package's own set beside another namespace's shipped one was refused by the store and reported still live, and the draft was not put back.
- **plugin-security's packaged-permission-set lock** (`packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.ts`): skips the lock only when the write is addressed to a package that, for every declarer, is not the declarer's pair and does not meet it. A write naming no package, and a name no source can classify (fail-closed `unknown`), are judged as before. Its exported `PermissionSetLockGateContext` gains the same optional `packageId`.
- **The plumbing**: `MetadataAuthoringGateContext` gains an optional `packageId`, the package the write is addressed to. The save door passes `request.packageId` (one line in `protocol-save.ts`). The restore path passes the row's binding. The private `runAuthoringGate` event type in `protocol.ts` gains the same optional field (one line).

## FROM → TO

Measured in `packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts` on this head. FROM was measured on the same harness with every non-test file of this diff reverted to `origin/main` (`5a755791a9`). Package `crm` (namespace `crm`) ships `N`. Every row holds in both registration orders (crm's set registered before or after the other packages install).

| Write of `N` | FROM (main) | TO (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| `hr` (namespace `hr`) saves its own `N` | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, "…is provided by a managed package and is sealed…" | saved; `hr`'s grant confers `hr`'s set, `crm`'s confers `crm`'s |
| `hr` saves its own `N` while `crm` and `fin` both ship `N` | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` | saved |
| `hr` saves its own `N` as a draft, then publishes it | draft save 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` | draft lands, publish promotes it, `hr`'s grant confers it |
| save naming no package | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (seal) | unchanged |
| save addressed to `crm` | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (seal) | unchanged |
| save addressed to `crm`'s customization pair (namespace `crmx`) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (seal) | unchanged |
| save addressed to a co-owner of `crm`'s namespace | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (seal) | unchanged |
| `fin` and `crm` ship `N`; save addressed to a co-owner of `crm`'s namespace | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (seal) | unchanged |
| the lock gate, for no package / `crm` / `crm`'s pair / `crm`'s co-owner | `PackagedPermissionSetLockedError` | unchanged |
| the lock gate, for `hr` | `PackagedPermissionSetLockedError` | passes |
| publish of a stored draft bound to `crm` or `crm`'s pair | (no such draft could be stored) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (the store's seal) |
| publish of a stored draft bound to no package or to `crm`'s co-owner | (no such draft could be stored) | 422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (the name rule, judged first) |

## Tests

New pins, as a top-level describe in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts`: `[#34226] a permission set is (package, name): the seal and the lock judge a save by the package it addresses`. The harness is the real protocol and the real `SchemaRegistry`, both aliased to source. Each case runs in both registration orders:

- `hr`'s own save lands, and each package's grant confers its own set;
- with two shippers, `hr`'s own save still lands;
- draft save then publish lands;
- CONTROLs at the save door: no package, `crm`, `crm`'s pair (other namespace), `crm`'s co-owner, and `fin`'s and `crm`'s co-owner. Each is asserted to be refused by the seal, not the lock;
- CONTROLs at the publish door: a stored draft bound to each of those addresses, with the code and status asserted;
- the lock gate itself: `hr` passes; no package, `crm`, the pair and the co-owner are locked;
- the undo of a refused package publish on a runtime that cannot roll back (`[#32396]` shape, created and edited): `hr`'s own N is reported `BATCH_ABORTED`, the active rows are as before the publish, and N's draft is back byte for byte.

The file's engine double now lists a table's own rows by the where's scalar equalities, answers a version's history row, and applies the caller's `limit` after its filter (`check:objectql-double-limit`).

Result at `b054ae27`: the full `plugin-security` suite, Test Files 271 passed (271), Tests 6753 passed | 45 skipped, which includes this file at 37 passed (37); under the verify lock with VERDICT command-exit 0.

<details><summary>FROM reading (H1): the pins on origin/main source</summary>

Every non-test file of the diff was restored from `5a755791a9` and the file was run: 16 failed | 17 passed (33). Every TO case and every case that needs `hr`'s draft failed. `hr`'s save was refused 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`: "Metadata item 'permission/qa_shared_reader' is provided by a managed package and is sealed against in-place edits. Clone it under a new name…". The save-door CONTROLs passed on main, so they hold as before. Afterwards each file's blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: thirteen legs, each red, each restored (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor x1 to x0)</summary>

The seal and lock legs were read from source through the test aliases, so no dist step applies.

| Leg | Result |
|---|---|
| S1: seal narrowing removed | 14 failed |
| S2: seal pair arm removed | 4 failed (the pair CONTROLs at the save and publish doors) |
| S3: seal meets arm removed | 8 failed |
| S4: seal judges the first shipper only | 2 failed (the `fin`/`crm` co-owner CONTROL) |
| I1: save write intent name-wide | 14 failed |
| I2: publish write intent name-wide | 2 failed (draft then publish) |
| P1: the save door hands the gate no package | 14 failed |
| L1: lock narrowing removed | 16 failed |
| L2: lock pair arm removed | 2 failed (the gate case) |
| L3: lock meets arm removed | 2 failed (the gate case) |
| U0: the undo's verdict removed (FROM) | 4 failed (created and edited, both orders) |
| U1: the undo's active-row intent at no package | 2 failed (edited: the restore is refused) |
| U2: the undo's returned-draft intent at no package | 2 failed (created: the draft put is refused) |

The U legs read `metadata-protocol` from source through the test alias, so no dist step applies; each restore was proved by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The final `git diff HEAD` was empty. The first P1 attempt was refused by the tool, because its replacement was a substring of the original text; it was re-run with a marked replacement.
</details>

<details><summary>H3 probe (not committed)</summary>

A scratch test called `refusePackagedBaseOverride` for `hr`'s own item of each package-scoped type while `crm` ships one. The answers are listed under Acceptance notes.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **H1** (both gates key on the name alone): confirmed, and there is a third judge. After the seal and the lock were narrowed, `hr`'s save was still refused 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` by the repository's managed seal, because the save door's write intent was computed from the name-wide artifact check. The draft promotion computes the same intent. Both are narrowed here through the same verdict.
- **H2**: confirmed for the four judges above. Every override of `crm`'s `N` stays sealed, including a save addressed to `crm`'s customization pair whose namespace differs from `crm`'s.
- **H3** (acceptance item 2), measured: every sealed package-scoped type shares the name-wide shape. With package `crm` shipping item X and package `hr` of another namespace, `refusePackagedBaseOverride` refuses `hr`'s own save of X as sealed for `flow`, `hook`, `job`, `webhook`, `mapping`, `connector`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`, `app`, `page`, `dataset`, `analytics_cube`, `picklist`, `book`, `api`, `tool`, `skill`, `agent`, and so for `permission` before this PR. `action`'s registration contract refused the bare probe body, but its seal is the same predicate. `dashboard`, `report` and `email_template` are not sealed (environment-overlay types). Only `permission` is changed here: the fix is not the same line for the others, because each type's identity and override channel differ.
- **Out of scope**, filed:
  - #34401: rollback and commit revert of a package's own permission set beside another namespace's shipped set still hand `restoreWriteFor` the name-wide intent, so the store refuses the restore (`protocol-package-commits.ts`, the `revertCommit` restore limb and `rollbackMetaItemUnaudited`). The `revertCommit` removal limb states the same intent, but the store admits it (below);
  - #34402: the other sealed package-scoped types listed under H3 keep the name-wide seal.
- **Delete and discard (L1 R1), measured: not refused, no code change.** `deleteMetaItem` still derives its removal intent from the name-wide `artifactBacked` (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, lines 642 and 851). The store admits that removal anyway: `SysMetadataRepository#assertDeleteAllowed` lets an `override-artifact` delete through for a `supportsOverlay` type, and `permission` is one (`supportsOverlay: true`), so `assertAllowed` is never reached. Measured at this head with a scratch case in the gate file's harness (not committed), in both registration orders: `hr` deleting its own active `N` answered `success: true` and removed the row, and `hr` discarding its own `N` draft answered `success: true` and removed the draft, while `crm` ships `N`.
- **Overlap**: PR #34238 edits the same `promoteDraftForPublish` host `Pick` line in `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`. Its head `0ed4158ef6` added `readItemActiveRows`, and this PR adds `engine`. At that head the two conflicted textually, and the resolution is the union of both members. At #34238's current head `db96228e6c` the merge-tree is clean. If the conflict returns, whichever PR lands second needs one mechanical merge of `main`.
- The seal's verdict and the lock's relation check are spelled once each, in their own packages (plugin-security cannot import `metadata-protocol` at runtime). Both are built only from the shared predicates `permissionSetHoldersMeet` (`@objectstack/core`) and `isPairOf` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`), and the pins hold the two in step at every address.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: one count goes 1 → 2 for the new pinned `findOne` double in the gate's test file, as `check:engine-double-contract` asks.

## Verification

The cast intersected `InstalledPackageSource` with a second `getPackage` signature, and the first signature (manifest `unknown`) won. The namespace is now read through the typed `installedManifestsOf` lookup. Build Core, the three Type Check lanes, Test Core and Live E2E UI all failed on that line. It is not on `main`: the file is new in this PR.
- **Review S1 / N1 / N2** (contract record 6915371853): S1 is fixed above (`undoLandedPromotions`), with the pins and the U legs. N1 and N2 are folded into the changeset and the `Clause-②:` line, which now read the same in both.

- `metadata-protocol` full suite at `343d5a7f` (its source is unchanged since): Test Files 345 passed | 9 skipped, Tests 22956 passed | 45 skipped.
- `plugin-security` full suite at `b054ae27`: Test Files 271 passed, Tests 6753 passed | 45 skipped.
